assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent syncope
The patient has transient episodes of cerebral ischemia
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology
The known diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome is present
Sick sinus syndrome is coded as I49.5
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded as CPT 93229
The service is intended to correlate symptomatic events with potential bradyarrhythmias or pauses
The service addresses detecting symptomatic pauses associated with documented syncope and sick sinus syndrome
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines
The provider has the right to appeal this determination
A formal appeal must be submitted within the timeframe specified in the provider agreement
Supporting clinical documentation justifying the medical necessity of the service should be included
Failure to adhere to these requirements may result in the finalization of this denial
